Troubleshooting · 46/50 · media

Duplicate assets diverge

Failure signal

A duplicate assets diverge condition is reported or detected during media.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for media does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Group files by content hash and compare metadata, approval state and storage role.

Corrective action

Choose one governed master, preserve required replicas and quarantine conflicting derivatives.

Prevention

Add this verification to the media gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
